title: Souls Message Banners
description: Elden ring/dark souls style titles for various events
body:
![preview of campfire lit](https://i.imgur.com/rovfHFC.gif)

This mod currently adds elden ring style NOUN VERBED titles that appear on certain events:

- Lighting up campfire
- Killing bosses (w/ special effect for the ender dragon)
- Raid victory/loss
- Activating a waystone ([Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones/versions))
- Lighting a bonfire ([Bonfires](https://modrinth.com/mod/bonfires/versions))

---
Message banners can be customized:

Built-in events can be toggled through the mod's config.
- "ENTITY FELLED" messages appear for all mobs tagged with #forge:bosses. You may also add custom entities via datapacks inside /data/<namespace>/smb_entities/[arbitrary_name].json. 
- Each banner can be customized via banner styles inside /assets/<namespace>/smb_styles/[banner_style].json

You may look on how to customize the banner styles [https://github.com/tablesouls/souls_message_banners/wiki](https://github.com/tablesouls/souls_message_banners/wiki).

Message banners can also be sent via commands, and ive also added light kubejs support which adds a single method:


```
MessageBannerAPI.send(player, "text", "souls_message_banners:default")
```


---
This mod is best paired with:

- [Campfire Spawn and Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/campfire-spawn-and-tweaks)
- [You Died](https://modrinth.com/mod/you-died) (very much inspiration for the mod!)
